latest_release.body:
# What's new in v1.17.0

## Shiny new things

- New "Autoplay videos" setting in General: turn it off and YouTube and Bilibili embeds, hover previews and media previews wait for a click before playing

## Improvements

- Changes made offline or while the server is unreachable are kept and sent as soon as the connection is back; only changes the server refuses are undone, and the app tells you why
- Offline, a feed without stored entries says it is offline instead of loading forever, and loads once you are back online
- Find in page keeps every keystroke, no longer counts its own text, steps through matches in order, has its editing menu back and leaves no highlights behind after closing
- Links to footnotes and other sections inside an entry scroll to them
- RSSHub routes that need a paid plan, such as X (Twitter), show an upgrade button in the follow form instead of a fetch error
- The RSSHub page explains that Folo's built-in instance is used first and your own instance is the fallback, and checks an instance address before saving it
- Editing Actions on two devices no longer overwrites the other device's rules: you can load the latest rules, keep editing or save over them
- Clearer, translated errors for a wrong email or password, too many requested emails, refused sign-in links and provider sign-ins, feeds the follow form could not load, and an unreachable server instead of "Failed to fetch"
- Verified accounts are told that an email change is approved from the current address first
- AI replies wait as long as the server does, and a stalled reply ends with the server's error in your language
- Saving media suggests a clean file name
- A Google Play subscription opens Google Play to manage it
- Analytics no longer receives your name, email or handle

## No longer broken

- Fixed a new device or browser replacing the account's AI shortcuts with the built-in ones after signing in
- Fixed the previous account's settings, including AI provider keys and MCP headers, being uploaded to another account that signed in on the same device
- Fixed signing out or switching accounts reopening the last entry, which the next account then marked as read
- Fixed changes queued under an expired session being sent with the next account's session
- Fixed stars and read marks clicked offline doing nothing and getting lost on reload
- Fixed setting changes that failed to send waiting for the next change or launch
- Fixed syncing starting up to a minute late after signing in on a new device
- Fixed unread counts after a refused Mark all as read, a deleted list or a feed removed from a list, and counts staying one below the server's after launch
- Fixed folder renames and subscription edits undoing changes made on other devices
- Fixed saved regex patterns such as (?i)foo blocking every later save of Actions
- Fixed a short timeline keeping a loading skeleton at its end after a refresh
- Fixed the window not refreshing stale data when brought back from the Dock or the tray
- Fixed push notifications stopping after a failed token upload until the next sign-in
- Fixed the follow form saying "Updated" after a first follow instead of "Followed"
- Fixed Discover offering Follow again after a restart for an RSSHub instance address you already follow
- Fixed MCP authorization reporting a blocked popup
- Fixed folo:// links with unknown paths opening hidden windows that never closed
- Fixed the find bar blocking clicks on the entry header buttons below it
- Fixed a subscription in an unknown view emptying the app
- Fixed the spacing of the Chinese "Mark as read" button

detail.readme:
Folo

   






Folo is an open-source AI RSS reader that brings everything you follow into one calm timeline, then helps you read it. Follow blogs, news sites, newsletters, podcasts, video channels and social feeds in one place, ask AI about what you read, get a digest of your day, and let summaries and translations do the heavy lifting. ## 👋🏻 Getting Started & Join Our Community Folo runs in the browser and on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux, and keeps your subscriptions, read status and stars in sync across all of them. It is under active development, and feedback is welcome for any [issue](https://github.com/RSSNext/Folo/issues) you run into. | Platform | Download | | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Web | | | iOS | | | Android | | | macOS | | | Windows | | | Linux | | You can also install using the following methods maintained by our community: - If you are using Arch Linux, you can install the package [folo-appimage](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/folo-appimage) that is maintained by [timochan](https://github.com/ttimochan) and [grtsinry43](https://github.com/grtsinry43). - If you are using Linux with [Flatpak](https://flatpak.org), you can install [Folo](https://flatpark.org/apps/is.folo.Folo/) from [FlatPark](https://flatpark.org) that is maintained by [Komh](https://github.com/jing2uo). - If you are using Nix, you can install the package [folo](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/pkgs/by-name/fo/folo/package.nix) that is maintained by [iosmanthus](https://github.com/iosmanthus). - If you are using macOS with [Homebrew](https://brew.sh), you can install the cask [folo](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/folo) that is maintained by [realSunyz](https://github.com/realSunyz). - If you are using Windows with [Scoop](https://scoop.sh), you can install the manifest [folo](https://github.com/cscnk52/cetacea/blob/master/bucket/folo.json) that is maintained by [cscnk52](https://github.com/cscnk52). | [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Fapi%2Finvites%2FAwWcAQ7euc%3Fwith_counts%3Dtrue&query=approximate_member_count&color=5865F2&label=Discord&labelColor=black&logo=discord&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://discord.gg/AwWcAQ7euc) | Join our Discord server to connect with developers, request features, and receive support. | | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/any_text-Follow-blue?color=2CA5E0&label=_&logo=x&labelColor=black&style=flat-square)](https://x.com/intent/follow?screen_name=folo_is) | Follow us on X for product updates. | > \[!IMPORTANT] > > **Star Us**, You will receive all release notifications from GitHub without any delay \~ ![Star Folo on GitHub](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a08f9437-b24c-4388-8f01-2826e09eeaf2) ## ✨ Features ### Folo AI Ask about an article, a feed, a folder or everything you follow. Pick your AI model or bring your own API key, and connect MCP services to bring your other tools into Folo AI. ![Folo AI: ask your feeds anything](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cd5a6455-0317-43a0-9bbb-9c0a5983fa12) ### Timeline Summary Turn hundreds of new entries into one quick digest of what matters. ![Timeline summary: your day, summarized](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1fb8b40c-481b-4f54-9170-844f2513349d) ### AI Translation and Summaries Read articles side by side with an AI translation in English, Chinese, Japanese or French, and get an AI summary of any article, on demand or automatically. ![AI translation: read the world in your language](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4396ee96-2bee-4332-ae49-4dc7c633ef8f) ### Every Format Articles, social posts, pictures, videos and podcasts each get a layout made for them, and text-to-speech reads any article aloud with natural voices. ![Every format: not just articles](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/46c85896-4c2c-4333-ab30-97721678740d) ### AI Tasks Schedule AI tasks that write daily or weekly briefings and deliver them to chat or email. ![AI tasks: briefings that write themselves](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/12b4a8bb-1590-4d5b-8e1a-8967456de1ce) ### Integrations Send articles to Obsidian, Readwise, Instapaper, Zotero, Cubox, Outline, Readeck or Eagle, and let Actions filter, star, rewrite, notify or summarize new entries with your own rules. ![Integrations: works with your tools](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5d45ab95-71a2-42b4-9631-332aee1ea343) ### On Your Phone Folo for iPhone, iPad and Android brings AI summaries, read-aloud and discovery with you, and picks up where you left off on your computer.

### And More - Subscribe to any RSS, Atom or JSON feed, plus thousands of [RSSHub](https://github.com/DIYgod/RSSHub) routes for sites without a feed - Import and export OPML to move from any other reader - An inbox with its own email address for newsletters - Customizable keyboard shortcuts and a command menu - Themes, reading fonts, custom CSS and code highlighting - Spotlight highlights the keywords you care about - Open source, with no ads ## 🤝 Contributing You are welcome to join the open source community to build together, please check our [Contributing Guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for more details. ## 🔏 Code signing policy Folo for Windows uses free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io/), a certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/). Folo for macOS and iOS is signed and notarized by [Apple Developer Program](https://developer.apple.com/programs/). All released files are verified with [GitHub artifact attestations](https://github.com/RSSNext/Folo/attestations) to ensure their provenance and integrity. ## 📝 License Folo is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License version 3 with the addition of the following special exception: All content in the `icons/mgc` directory is copyrighted by https://mgc.mingcute.com/ and cannot be redistributed.
